result.instructions: Tools for Checkfront, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Checkfront data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run checkfront_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run checkfront_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run checkfront_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. checkfront_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: checkfront_get_company
tools.title: Get company settings
tools.description: Fetch the connected Checkfront account's company configuration — name, URL, plan, currency, timezone, locale and date/time formats. A cheap way to confirm the host and credentials work. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/company.

tools.name: checkfront_list_categories
tools.title: List item categories
tools.description: List the inventory categories (e.g. Tours, Rentals, Accommodations) with their ids, names, display order and item counts. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/category.

tools.name: checkfront_list_items
tools.title: List inventory items (optionally with availability and rates)
tools.description: List the enabled inventory items (tours, activities, rentals, rooms). With NO dates this is the plain catalogue. Pass start_date (and end_date / param quantities) to get a RATED response: per-item availability, pricing and a SLIP token — the SLIP is what checkfront_add_to_booking_session needs to book the item. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/item.

keyword.description: Only items whose name contains this keyword.

item_id.description: Comma-separated list of item ids to filter to, e.g. 17,18.

available.description: (rated) Only items with at least this many left in stock.

start_date.description: (rated) Booking start date — YYYYMMDD, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative date such as "today".

end_date.description: (rated) Booking end date — YYYYMMDD, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative date such as "today".

date.description: (rated) Alias of start_date for same-day bookings — YYYYMMDD, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative date such as "today".

param.description: Booking parameters (quantities) keyed by the parameter ids configured in your account, e.g. {"adults": 2, "children": 1}. Sent as param[adults]=2.

discount_code.description: (rated) Discount code to apply to the price.

rules.description: 'soft' avoids date-based rule errors; 'off' disables rule checking.

tools.name: checkfront_get_item
tools.title: Get an item (optionally with availability and rates)
tools.description: Fetch one inventory item's details. Pass start_date / end_date and param quantities (e.g. {"adults": 2}) for a RATED response with availability (rate.status, rate.available), the price breakdown and the SLIP used to book it. For parent/child grouped items, rate the CHILD item. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/item/{item_id}.

start_date.description: (rated) Booking start date — YYYYMMDD, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative date such as "today".

end_date.description: (rated) Booking end date — YYYYMMDD, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative date such as "today".

date.description: (rated) Alias of start_date for same-day bookings — YYYYMMDD, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative date such as "today".

param.description: Booking parameters (quantities) keyed by the parameter ids configured in your account, e.g. {"adults": 2, "children": 1}. Sent as param[adults]=2.

discount_code.description: (rated) Discount code to apply to the price.

rules.description: 'soft' avoids date-based rule errors; 'off' disables rule checking.

tools.name: checkfront_get_availability_calendar
tools.title: Get an availability calendar
tools.description: Day-by-day available inventory over a date range — for one item (item_ids with a single id), several items, or a whole category. Use it to answer 'which days next month still have space?'. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/item/{item_id}/cal or GET /api/3.0/item/cal.

item_ids.description: Item ids. One id queries that item's calendar; several query them together.

category_id.description: Instead of item ids, a category of items.

start_date.description: Range start date — YYYYMMDD, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative date such as "today".

end_date.description: Range end date — YYYYMMDD, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative date such as "today".

tools.name: checkfront_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings, newest filters first — by status, customer, dates, item or partner. Each row has the booking code, status, totals (total, tax_total, paid_total), customer name/email, summary and date_desc. Paged (default 100/page); the response's request.pages tells you how many pages exist. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/booking/index.

status_id.description: Booking status code, e.g. PEND, HOLD, PART, PAID, WAIT, STOP, VOID.

customer_id.description: Only bookings for this customer id.

customer_email.description: Only bookings for this customer email.

start_date.description: Booking start (check-in) date. A date string or unix timestamp; prefix with '<' or '>' for before/after (e.g. ">2026-01-01").

end_date.description: Booking end (check-out) date. A date string or unix timestamp; prefix with '<' or '>' for before/after (e.g. ">2026-01-01").

created_date.description: Date the booking was created. A date string or unix timestamp; prefix with '<' or '>' for before/after (e.g. ">2026-01-01").

last_modified.description: Date the booking last changed — useful for 'changed since' syncs. A date string or unix timestamp; prefix with '<' or '>' for before/after (e.g. ">2026-01-01").

partner_id.description: Only bookings attributed to this partner account.

tools.name: checkfront_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Fetch extended information on one booking — status, dates, customer, form fields, line items and totals. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/booking/{booking_id}.

booking_id.description: The booking code identifying the booking, e.g. CFPP-290317.

tools.name: checkfront_list_booking_notes
tools.title: List booking notes
tools.description: List the notes left on bookings across the account (default: the past 30 days), each with its booking code, author account id (0 = customer), date, body and whether it is private. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/booking/notes.

date.description: Filter by a day (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601) or a whole month (e.g. "2026-09").

tools.name: checkfront_get_booking_form
tools.title: Get the booking form fields
tools.description: Fetch the customer-details form for a booking (booking_form_ui): every field id (customer_name, customer_email, …), its label, type and whether it is required. Call this before checkfront_create_booking to know which `form` fields to send. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/booking/form.

tools.name: checkfront_get_booking_session
tools.title: Get a booking session (cart)
tools.description: Read a booking session — the in-progress 'cart' — with its line items (keyed by line_id), dates, sub_total, tax, total and amount due. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/booking/session.

tools.name: checkfront_search_customers
tools.title: Search customers
tools.description: Look up customers by exact email, full name or phone number (exact matches; non-unique fields such as name can return several). Results are in the `customers` object. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/customer.

tools.name: checkfront_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Fetch one customer's contact details and their bookings (codes with created dates). Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/customer/{customer_id}.

customer_id.description: The customer id (e.g. 25) or customer code.

tools.name: checkfront_list_events
tools.title: List events (seasons, specials, closures, discounts)
tools.description: List the date-based events that change price or availability — seasonal rates (SE), specials (SP), discounts (DC), closures (status U) — with their dates, recurrence, pricing rule and the items/categories they apply to. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/event.

tools.name: checkfront_list_staff_accounts
tools.title: List staff accounts
tools.description: List the staff (and partner) accounts on the Checkfront account — ids, names, emails, login ids and whether enabled. The account_id is what CHECKFRONT_ON_BEHALF takes. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/account.

tools.name: checkfront_add_to_booking_session
tools.title: Add items to a booking session (cart)
tools.description: Start or modify a booking session: add one or more SLIPs (from a rated checkfront_get_item / checkfront_list_items call), replace a line with a new SLIP (line_id + slip), or alter lines (quantity, 'remove', 'optin'/'optout' for package add-ons). Holds the inventory while the session is open; NOTHING is booked until checkfront_create_booking. Returns the session_id to reuse. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/session.

session_id.description: Existing session to modify. Omit to start a new session.

slip.description: One or more SLIP strings to add, e.g. ["18.20171005X1-adults.1-children.0"].

line_id.description: With a single slip: the session line to REPLACE with it (to change a regular item's options).

alter.description: Changes keyed by line_id, e.g. {"3": 5, "2.1": "optin", "1": "remove"} (a number sets the quantity).

annotations.title: Add items to a booking session

tools.name: checkfront_end_booking_session
tools.title: End or clear a booking session
tools.description: Abandon a booking session: 'clear' empties its items, 'end' closes it. Releases the inventory it was holding; no booking is affected. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/session/clear or /booking/session/end.

session_id.description: The session to clear or end.

annotations.title: End or clear a booking session

tools.name: checkfront_create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: Commit a booking: from a session_id (built with checkfront_add_to_booking_session) or directly from SLIPs, plus the customer form fields (see checkfront_get_booking_form for which are required — typically customer_name and customer_email). Creates a real reservation that consumes inventory and may notify the customer; change it later with checkfront_update_booking_status. Returns the new booking's ids and any invoice/payment URL. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/create.

session_id.description: The session holding the items to book.

slip.description: Instead of a session: SLIP strings to book directly.

form.description: Customer form fields, e.g. {"customer_name": "John Smith", "customer_email": "john@example.com"}. Sent as form[customer_name]=….

tools.name: checkfront_update_booking_status
tools.title: Change a booking's status
tools.description: Set a booking's status — e.g. confirm a pending booking (PAID/PART), put it on HOLD or WAIT(list), or cancel it (VOID/STOP). Reversible: set it back to the previous status the same way. Does NOT record a payment. Optionally triggers the account's customer notifications. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/{booking_id}/update.

booking_id.description: The booking code identifying the booking, e.g. CFPP-290317.

status_id.description: The new status code. Defaults: PEND, HOLD, PART, PAID, WAIT, STOP, VOID (plus any custom statuses in Manage > Layout > Statuses).

notify.description: Send the account's notifications for this change (default false).

tools.name: checkfront_add_booking_note
tools.title: Add a note to a booking
tools.description: Add a note to a booking, logged under the staff account the API acts on behalf of. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/{booking_id}/note.

booking_id.description: The booking code identifying the booking, e.g. CFPP-290317.

body.description: The note text, up to 3000 characters.

annotations.title: Add a note to a booking

tools.name: checkfront_check_in_booking
tools.title: Check a booking in or out
tools.description: Mark a guest as arrived (check in) or departed (check out). Checkfront adds a note under the acting account. VOID and cancelled bookings cannot be checked in or out. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/{booking_id}/checkin or /checkout.

booking_id.description: The booking code identifying the booking, e.g. CFPP-290317.

annotations.title: Check a booking in or out
